title: Option-Aware Crop-Root Geometry Snapshot Producer
purpose: Produce the explicit read-only crop_root_geometry_snapshot_t consumed by F-WOF16 from option-appropriate committed crop state and immutable root-depth parameters, without creating a universal duplicate root-depth state or implementing root-growth evolution.

SWRD_2.current_root_depth: exact committed actual_root_depth pass-through after validation
SWRD_2.potential_root_depth: not consumed by the current-root geometry view

inactive_route.rule: crop_emerged=false produces the canonical inactive geometry snapshot without consulting stale DVS, WRT, root-depth or interpolation-table values
inactive_route.reason: legacy crop fields can retain stale values outside the active crop route and F-WOF11/F-WOF13 already qualify dependency-free inactive semantics

validation: active maximum root depth must be finite and strictly positive
SWRD=1 active DVS must be finite and RDTB x/y arrays must be finite, same-sized and strictly increasing in x
SWRD=2 committed actual root depth must be finite, nonnegative and no greater than maximum root depth
SWRD=3 active WRT must be finite and nonnegative and RLWTB x/y arrays must be finite, same-sized and strictly increasing in x
interpolated root depth must be finite and nonnegative before clipping
structured table interpolation must reproduce AFGEN endpoint clamping and linear interpolation semantics
state_and_memory_rules: Do not persist a duplicate current_root_depth for SWRD=1 or SWRD=3 solely to feed root uptake.
Do not create any per-node state in this workunit.
SWRD=2 actual_root_depth remains committed physical history owned by the crop/root evolution path and is only read here.
The geometry snapshot is reconstructible/read-only output, not an independent transaction authority.
qualification_tests: inactive dependency-free route for all three modes
SWRD=1 AFGEN interior and endpoint cases against independent legacy oracle
SWRD=3 AFGEN interior and endpoint cases against independent legacy oracle
composition with F-WOF16 nonadaptive root-view producer
forbidden: root-growth evolution or daily cropdevelopment(3) scheduling
persistent noddrz or cumulative root-distribution fields
legacy packed-table representation in the production API
runtime, solver, HeadCalc or file-I/O dependencies
